summary: csvflow-schema postinstall spawns calc.exe and beacons installer identity to external host
details: csvflow-schema advertises itself as a CSV schema helper but ships a postinstall.js that, on npm install, unconditionally spawns calc.exe via `cmd /c start` and performs an HTTPS GET to the hardcoded non-publisher host cdn-status.mulderitsme.net with a per-install identifier path (/pi/2c75177b). The script also collects local identity data (os.userInfo().username, os.hostname(), process.cwd(), ppid) into a temp file. The code execution primitive (arbitrary child_process spawn at install time) and the callback to a hardcoded third-party host unrelated to any CSV functionality are consistent with a dropper or PoC that proves arbitrary code execution and network reachability on the installer. The declared package purpose (CSV schema helper) has no need for child_process, calculator invocation, or beaconing to an external domain.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
